sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/marquettemi (Campspot park record as cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13)

values.note: City of Marquette 2027 rates: $45 electric, $55 full hook-up; $30 primitive/tent sites (no vehicles on tent sites). One rate for everyone. $7 reservation fee per booking, $20 cancellation fee, $10 early check-in when available.

fees.source: https://marquettemi.gov/community-services/parks-and-recreation/tourist-park/ ('2027 Rates: $30 primitive/tent site, $45 electric, $55 full hook-up. $10 early check-in as available.'; 'There is a $7.00 reservation fee'; 'No vehicles permitted on tent sites'; '$20.00 cancellation fee'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://marquettemi.gov/community-services/parks-and-recreation/tourist-park/ ('One hundred sites provide electrical hookups ... There are 38 sites with water and sewer service') + Campspot site types ('50-Amp'), read 2026-10-22 / 2026-10-13

values.note: Firewood sold on site (outside firewood not allowed); hammock stands for rent; beach on the Dead River.

facilities.source: https://marquettemi.gov/community-services/parks-and-recreation/tourist-park/ ('Campground facilities also include hot showers, restrooms/flush toilets, sanitary dump stations and paved roads'; 'we sell firewood on site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2027 season May 21 - October 17 'depending on weather' (2026 ran May 22 - October 17); the dates shift a day or two each year.

season.source: https://marquettemi.gov/community-services/parks-and-recreation/tourist-park/ ('The camping season begins May 21st, 2027 and ends October 17th, 2027 depending on weather'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online booking for the 2027 season opens January 4, 2027 at 8:00 am Eastern; online reservations must be made at least two days ahead. 14 consecutive nights at most, then 48 hours away before returning. Changes or cancellations 72 hours before check-in. The reservation name and address must match the occupant; no third-party reservations.

booking.source: https://marquettemi.gov/community-services/parks-and-recreation/tourist-park/ ('Campsite bookings for the 2027 season at Tourist Park open Monday, January 4th, 2027 at 8:00am EST'; 'Online reservations must be made at least two days in advance'; 'Limit stay on all sites: 14 nights. You may return again after 48 hours'; Campsite Reservations link to https://www.campspot.com/book/marquettemi), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the City of Marquette's page: 100 electric sites (38 with water/sewer), showers/flush toilets/dump, $7 reservation fee, booked on Campspot (/book/marquettemi). Changed fees low 30 -> 45: the $30 sites are tent-only ('No vehicles permitted on tent sites'), so the base is $45 electric (2027 rates $45/$55). Changed season opens 05-22 -> 05-21 (2027 season May 21 - Oct 17). Added flush toilets, 14-night limit and booking rules. No resident/non-resident split. Site count (110) and max 44 ft left (the city doesn't state them).
flags: Phone: the city page gives the Tourist Park office as (906) 228-0465 (Campspot lists the same); the entry has 906-228-0460.
Second website link is the Campspot marketplace slug https://www.campspot.com/park/tourist-park-campground-marquette-mi; the city's own booking link is https://www.campspot.com/book/marquettemi.
